title: Latency Accordion Inspector + Cost Grove wireframes
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design a compact, vertical accordion-style inspector for per-route and per-model performance that surfaces latency distributions, throughput bands, and token-cost attribution inline with a side "Cost Grove" module — a lightweight explorable cost breakdown that ties tokens -> kernels -> GPUs for quick triage. Goal is to reduce mean time to insight for platform engineers and SREs troubleshooting model regressions while keeping the main dashboard decluttered.
acceptance_criteria: Accordion rows render for each model-route with 3 visual states: collapsed (summary), expanded (detailed charts), pinned (persistent)
Latency mini-histogram + p50/p90/p99 callouts visible in collapsed state
Expanded state shows token waterfall, throughput sparkline, and kernel selection heatmap with hover drill to sample traces
Cost Grove displays token-cost attribution by segment and suggests 2 optimization actions (batching, quantization tier) with estimated cost delta
Design tokens and spacing conform to Console design system; components are responsive to narrow side panels
Prototype linked to Figma has interactive accordion toggles and hover states for microtraces
decisions: Chose vertical accordion over horizontal tabs to prioritize vertical screen real-estate on ops consoles
Use simplified mini-histogram in collapsed state to avoid heavy query load in list views
Cost Grove will be precomputed for hosted routes; for Dedicated/Private we show cached estimates with a manual "Recalculate" CTA
Dropped an initial idea to show full KV-cache heatmap inline due to complexity; will surface via trace drill instead
